title.value:
A New Era: Intelligent Tutoring Systems
Will Transform Online Learning for Millions
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote:
A New Era: Intelligent Tutoring Systems
Will Transform Online Learning for Millions

extractions.description: The paper discusses the potential of AI-powered learning to provide personalized and practical learning experiences, especially in online learning platforms. It presents a comparative study between a traditional MOOC platform and the Korbit learning platform, demonstrating significantly increased learning outcomes with the personalized Korbit platform.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper explicitly mentions the alignment of AI-enabled solutions in education with the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly ensuring inclusive and equitable high-quality education and promoting life-long learning opportunities for all.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote:
In the educational domain, AI-enabled solutions
can help ensure inclusive and equitable high-quality educa-
tion and promote life-long learning opportunities for all in ac-
cordance with the United Nations’ Sustainable Development
Goals (SDGs).

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on ensuring accessibility of high-quality education for people around the globe, which aligns with supporting education in developing countries.
primary_category.quote:
One urgent area to which AI
could and should contribute is education, in particular, ensur-
ing accessibility of high-quality education for people around
the globe.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper promotes the sharing of knowledge on how to use AI to improve the quality of education, especially in online learning systems.
primary_sub_category.quote:
This implies that AI researchers
must focus their efforts on the application of AI to improve
the quality of education, in particular in the context of on-
line learning systems.
